details:
- CVE-2024-31080: xorg-x11-server: fix heap-based buffer over-read
  vulnerability in ProcXIGetSelectedEvents() by avoiding byte-swapped
  length values in replies
- CVE-2024-9632: xorg-x11-server: fix improperly tracked allocation size
  in _XkbSetCompatMap to prevent buffer overflow condition
- CVE-2024-31081: xorg-x11-server: fix heap-based buffer over-read
  vulnerability in ProcXIPassiveGrabDevice() function to prevent memory
  leakage and segmentation faults by handling byte-swapped length values
  in replies correctly
